changes: Renamed GPT to AI Journal and combined the review header, controls, and draft list.
Added automatic inbox checking every 60 seconds while signed in, online and authorized; kept Refresh drafts as a fallback.
Added AI Journal draft notifications through the existing bell; selecting a draft opens the card and highlights it. Website-update notifications open the update dialog.
Added stable year-based AI source references without dashes (AI260001, AI270001) in a separate Sheet column and at the start of the review description; official journal IDs remain unchanged.
Moved the AI draft editor immediately below the AI Journal header, fixed Reset to restore the source draft, and aligned table column widths.
Google authorization remains browser-session-only. A secure server-side OAuth connection is still needed to avoid reauthorization after site updates.
